stemMd: A product costs 72 euros to make and is sold at a 25% markup on cost. What percentage of the selling price is gross profit?
explanationMd: The price is 90 and profit is 18. Margin uses price as its denominator: 18/90=20%, unlike markup.

distractorRationale.d: Uses a reciprocal percentage relationship incorrectly.
distractorRationale.a: Treats the monetary profit as a percentage.
